page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Greek letters are doubtful at this scan resolution; Hebrew and Greek readings may be off in places, notably the points on טָפִי, שַׂגִּי, טְפוּף and the Greek τύπω, which may read differently. The printer's ornament between the rule and the second block is not transcribed. The Hebrew headword forms at the start of each entry follow the printed order as closely as legible.
